Annual Budget Reporting
For the fiscal year July 1 - June 30

Reporting Requirements
All School Administrative Units

  • Upload the following files to the Maine Education Financial System (MEFS) Financial by August 15:
    •    Budget Revenue
    •      Budget Expenditure
  • Before submitting, check that all files:
    • Contain data for all funds
    • Contain revenue and expenditure transactions for all funds
    • Are created for the full-year budget under Quarter 1
  • Email the following to the School Finance Consultant - Terri.Beal@maine.gov
    • Warrant Articles
    • Budget Meeting Minutes
    • Voter declaration of the referendum (if required)
  • After submitting:
    • Sign in to the Maine Education Financial System and check the file status:
      • If there are errors, resolve and resubmit
      • If the file is in approved status, complete the file submission by electronic certification
      • NOTE: Only file submissions in migrated status are considered received by Maine DOE.

SADs, RSUs, CSDs

  • Submit the EF-M-46 in NEO

CTE Regions

  • Submit the EF-M-46V in NEO

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Annual Budget Reporting For the fiscal year July" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 12 links on this page open a file — 5 Excel, 4 Word, 2 PDF, 1 RTF — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Put the card titles on one level
decisions.why: 3 card titles are written at a level copied from an example rather than chosen — h5 on a page whose sections are h2. Only the number changes.

decisions.label: Drop the dash once the link is set apart
decisions.why: 1 of those items separate the link from its description with a dash. The link is now set in the display face at a larger size with a chevron after it, so the dash marks a boundary that is already unmistakable. Only the separator is removed — no word changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 1 list item opens with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Let a colon do its own work
decisions.why: A colon marks the words before it as a term and the words after it as what the term means. Here 2 list items open with a term set in the same weight as its own explanation, so the list cannot be scanned. No word changes and nothing is removed.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 1 email address sits in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
decisions.removes: School Finance - Budgets & Guidance Web Banner .png

decisions.label: Start a description with a capital
decisions.why: 1 description begins with a small letter, because it used to run on from the link after a dash. The dash is gone and the link now sits above in its own face, so each description opens a line of its own. One character changes and only ever the first.
